scope: Fresh source bytes selected after original-page inspection and before provider runs. Related government circular/form families have prior exposure; engineering transfer only, no held-out accuracy claim.

checks: Nested audit sub-tables, rotated row-group labels, boxed identifiers/dates, checkboxes and blank entry fields; preserve notes and choices without filling them.
Adjacent pages remain separately identified; no continuation inferred from row numbers or similar grids.
Thin-sheet bleed-through, wrapped income conditions, percent/range critical characters and same-page narrative.
Surcharge rows cross the page boundary; keep the old-regime context distinct from the separate new-regime table. No automatic joining or current-law approval.

coverage_gaps: No Hindi-body table in the acquired audit-form PDF: Hindi appears in the running header only. Do not count this as Hindi table validation.
The native audit pages are rasterized comparison controls; they do not establish real-scan quality.
Scanned circular contains an OCR layer, withheld from image providers; real image-only originals remain absent.
No accepted references, filled taxpayer examples, handwriting, broad script coverage or general table accuracy.
policy: No provider receives source text, native table geometry, expected counts, correction examples or owner feedback. Preserve all failures and unchanged raw output. No auto-join, engine selection or publication.
